summary: Fentress County lookout listed as removed in a Tennessee tower inventory; no other source found on its history.

facts.status_note: Listed as removed; no source describes what, if anything, remains at the site.

evidence.supports: Fentress County, 1,759 ft elevation, district-tower 4-3, removed
4-3 is a district-tower number from a 1976 list of state forest towers
evidence.quote: Numbers in the table (e.g., 4-7) are state forest tower numbers (district-tower) from 1976 list of towers

evidence.supports: author gave unofficial names to towers not named on USGS maps or the state forestry list
evidence.quote: I have given unofficial names to towers that were not named on the USGS maps or on the list of towers provided by the state forestry office

evidence.supports: Pickett tower in Fentress County, 1,720 ft, standing, listed separately
CCC erected 98 lookout towers in Tennessee, 1933-1941
evidence.quote: From 1933 to 1941, the Civilian Conservation Corps erected 98 lookout towers in Tennessee.

evidence.supports: many towers removed; most former locations private property
evidence.quote: Many have been removed, and most locations are now private property

notes_for_editor: One source only: a personal, unofficial inventory. The author says some tower names are their own, so 'Skinner Mountain' may not be an official name. No build, design, staffing or fire record found. Search results mentioned a Skinner Mountain Wildlife Management Area (TWRA) and a topo summit near 1,804 ft; neither page was read (the TWRA page returned HTTP 403), so neither is cited and the story does not link the tower to the WMA. The inventory's Pickett tower (FET004, standing) may need its own record. No correction proposed; the record's coordinates were not checked against any source that describes the site.
